thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: GPU capacity alert for aws-sa-east1. Autoscaler attempted 4 scale-ups in last 3m but all hit regional quota limits (quota.remaining=0). Observed queue growth on inference-worker pool, 1200 pending requests, p95 latency spiking to 2.6s. Pager sent to @oncall-miguel and @sre-alyssa

oncall-miguel: I'm on it. grabbing logs now. can someone post the autoscaler error lines?

sre-alyssa: seeing this in autoscaler logs: `ERROR: allocate_gpus: quota_exceeded: requested 32, available 0` and `Autoscaler: scale_up_rejected: region_quota_limit`. also K8s shows Pending Pods due to InsufficientGPUs.

infra-sam: confirmed with cloud console — account GPU quota for sa-east1 hit hard limit. There was a spike in spot allocations earlier, looks like other teams used leftover capacity. We have no soft quota remaining.

eng-runtime-lee: quick mitigation options: 1) failover routing to eu-west1/gcp where we have headroom, 2) lower batch size / enable emergency quantize profile for low-priority lanes, 3) drop non-critical background jobs. Which should we try first?

oncall-miguel: do option 1 + 3 in parallel. Start failing over new requests for customers flagged as >=P1? Actually we should move non-critical tenants first. @ops-bot can you flip routing config?

ops-bot: running routing change: `redwood-router set-fallback --from aws-sa-east1 --to gcp-eu-west1 --filter tenant_priority<=1`

ops-bot: routing change queued, applying to 8 frontend instances. expected propagation ~45s.

cs-nina: heads-up — we have two paying customers in SA region currently experiencing elevated latencies (Customer: VerdeMaps, Customer: LojaAI). I'll draft a brief saying we're working on automatic failover and expect restoration in ~10m. Please call out no data loss and some requests may be routed to eu.

product-oliver: confirm rollback plan: if eu saturates, we'll fallback to degraded mode (serve smaller responses) and circuit-break low-req traffic. Also schedule post-incident to consider regional quota reservation product.

infra-sam: temporary manual quota bump request submitted to cloud provider (support case 2456789). ETA uncertain (minutes to hours). Not a real-time fix.

eng-runtime-lee: started a quick config to reduce default batch_tokens from 2048->1024 for non-critical lanes. Command: 
```
redwood-config set inference.batch_tokens --scope noncritical --value 1024
```
This should reduce per-request GPU memory and allow a few more pods to schedule if partial capacity exists.

sre-alyssa: monitoring: queue dropped from 1200 -> 520 after routing change started. p95 down to 1.2s. Good signal. Keep routing until quota bump or more permanent mitigation.

oncall-miguel: @cs-nina push the customer note now: short blurb + ETA ~10-15m, mention failover to EU, possible higher latency for affected requests.

cs-nina: sent to VerdeMaps and LojaAI. I'll include ops contact and offer status updates every 15m.

ops-bot: routing propagation complete on frontends. New requests matching filter are routed to gcp-eu-west1.

eng-runtime-lee: also enabled emergency quantize profile for background lanes: `quantize-profile: q4_0_emergency` — should reduce memory footprint ~30%. Applied to noncritical service class.

sre-alyssa: autoscaler attempted one more scale-up and got `quota_exceeded` again but since frontends are routing away, pending pods reduced. Cluster stable for now.

infra-sam: cloud support responded: quota request acknowledged, provisional increase requires account verification, ETA 2-6 hours. No immediate increase.

product-oliver: action item: schedule reserved quota purchase for SA region. This incident shows we can't rely on soft pool.

oncall-miguel: status update to #product and #support: mitigation in place (failover to eu + quantify/batch reductions). Customers notified. Partial recovery observed. Keep monitoring for 30m.

ops-bot: posting metrics snapshot:
```
pending_requests: 512 -> 210 (post-mitigation)
p95_latency_ms: 2600 -> 1200 -> 800
failed_scale_attempts: 5 -> 1
```

cs-nina: customers acknowledged. VerdeMaps asked about data locality — explained inference-only routing, no customer data persisted, and EU compute will be used transiently. They accepted.

eng-runtime-lee: plan for follow-up: 1) add regional reserved quota request (ops), 2) implement automatic cross-region failover policy for Sa region when quota_exceeded observed (engineering), 3) add low-latency notification banner for customers in region (product/CS). Assign owners?

sre-alyssa: I'll own the runbook update for autoscaler: make quota_exceeded trigger auto-failover after 2 consecutive rejections.

infra-sam: ops will own quota purchase and cloud support follow-up.

product-oliver: product will own customer messaging template + banner.

cs-nina: CS will do outbound follow-ups to the two impacted customers and compile impact summary.

oncall-miguel: good. final status: incident mitigated — traffic rerouted and queue stabilizing. We'll keep thread open until quota secured or permanent changes deployed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident record created: INC-2023-3051236789. Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime-lee, due in 3 business days.

ops-bot: scheduling reminder for postmortem in 48h.

sre-alyssa: leaving note: consider per-tenant throttles to avoid noisy neighbor exhaustion in the future.

oncall-miguel: signing off but staying available. If anything flares, tag me.

eng-runtime-lee: will open a GH issue for automatic failover and quota alarms.

cs-nina: will attach customer convo and transcripts to incident.

product-oliver: thanks team. closing thread in 30m if stable.
